lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 high-contrast vertical lines are visible; spacing is relatively uniform, though slightly wider between the 5th and 6th lines on the mid-torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A distinct Y-shaped bifurcation occurs on the lower third of the 7th vertical line from the anterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first three anterior lines and the 6th line are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the ventral hair fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct white spots are located on the mid-posterior haunch in a vertical configuration.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a lyrate trajectory, emerging at an approximate 45-degree angle from the skull before curving inward and upward at the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the apical tips is approximately 1.9x the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately 12% of the overall vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal crest extending from the neck to the rump; distinct high-contrast orange coloration on the lower limbs below the carpus and tarsus.
